claims.nodeLabel: DoD Instruction 3204.01 - Oversight of Independent Research and Development
claims.sourceText: DoD Instruction 3204.01, 20 August 2014, incorporating Change 2, 9 July 2020
claims.text: IR&D costs 'will be allowable as indirect expenses on covered contracts to the extent they are allocable and reasonable'; reporting is required only of major contractors allocating over $11 million in IR&D and B&P costs, via project summaries reviewed for cost allowability.

claims.sourceText: DoD Instruction 3204.01, 20 August 2014, incorporating Change 2, 9 July 2020
claims.text: Corporate independent research and development is recoverable as an indirect expense on covered DoD contracts under DoD Instruction 3204.01, with project reporting required only of contractors allocating more than $11 million in IR&D and bid-and-proposal costs.
